dict.string: Spectra listens for nearby Bluetooth radios so it can show their signal strength live. Nothing is stored or sent.
Spectra uses the camera as a light meter, and LiDAR and AR so it can time light's round trip and place waves in your room. Camera frames are never recorded or saved.
Spectra reads your location fix so it can show how precisely satellites are locating you and where true north is. Your location stays on this iPhone.
Spectra turns sound into a live Fourier spectrum so you can compare it with light and radio. Audio stays on this phone and is never recorded.
Spectra reads the barometer so it can show air pressure and how the air bends radio waves. Readings stay on this iPhone.
Spectra measures the distance to your other device with ultra wideband radio so it can show how the radio times its pulses. Nothing is stored or sent.
